guidance_format:
RESPOND ONLY in JSON format: ```json { "guidance_type": "STRATEGIC_ADVICE" | "FLOW_CHANGE" | "NO_GUIDANCE", "suggestion": "Brief strategic suggestion (max 100 chars)", "reasoning": "Concise reasoning (max 150 chars)" } ```
GUIDANCE TYPES: - STRATEGIC_ADVICE: General optimization recommendation - FLOW_CHANGE: Specific strategy or focus change needed - NO_GUIDANCE: Current approach is optimal, continue
